]> 30/07/2026 7:26 Another 7cm, snowmaking and clear skies!.

We had another 7cm throughout the day yesterday and into last night, bringing the storm total to 15cm. With wind-blown pockets, you can definitely find some deeper stashes out there. The temperature remained cold, so we've also had a really solid run of snowmaking with the guns still running this morning and adding to the coverage.

It's currently -4.7 degrees in Perisher Valley and we're headed for a top of 2 degrees. The wind is around 15km/h from the south-west and it's forecast to stay that way for most of the day. The sky is clear, and with 37 groomed runs across the resort, 30 lifts expected to open and a cold, dry snow surface, plus plenty of powder stashes, this could be the day of the season so far!

Blue Calf T-Bar will come back online to give people in Guthega an option for skiing and riding, giving us four resort areas open once again!

Around the resort, there's live music at Jax and in Blue Cow this afternoon. Check the Events page or follow Perisher's socials to stay across all the action.

Head out there and have a great day!
